description.value: Price Creek Park is a 7.32-hectare natural conservation area in Surrey's Fleetwood neighbourhood, established to protect the Price and Cub Creek watersheds and over 1,344 metres of sensitive riparian habitat. The park includes a large meadow along 146 Street ideal for picnicking or casual games, as well as natural forested areas. It has been in City of Surrey stewardship since the late 1970s.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content from surrey.ca confirms Price Creek Park's identity, address (8564 - 146 Street, Surrey BC), and phone (604-501-5050). The OSM record lists the community as Richmond, but the website clearly places the park in Surrey's Fleetwood neighbourhood — a notable discrepancy. The park description focuses on conservation and passive recreation (frisbee, picnicking); no bike parking, washrooms, water, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but park address and website confirm the location is in Surrey, BC (Fleetwood neighbourhood) — possible OSM geocoding or community-assignment error.
No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned on the park webpage; all required criteria remain unconfirmed.
